candidate_relations.reason: Pyknodysostosis is an accepted alternate spelling of Pycnodysostosis; the addition of 'with short stature' is a harmless descriptor of a cardinal feature of the condition and does not alter the diagnostic entity. The clinical record supports this diagnosis with osteosclerosis, acro-osteolysis, open fontanel with Wormian bones, frontal bossing, micrognathia, and short stature in a child of consanguineous parents.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pyknodysostosis with short stature vs. Pycnodysostosis

case_quality_flags: Consanguinity (first-degree cousins) consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance of pycnodysostosis (CTSK mutation)
All classic features present: osteosclerosis, acro-osteolysis, open fontanel, Wormian bones, frontal bossing, micrognathia, short stature
